text.en:
The old provincial capitol building of the Province of Antique located in the Municipality of San
Jose shall hereafter be known and referred to as the Justice Calixto O. Zaldivar Memorial Hall of Justice.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 7, 1984
